releaseNotes:
## 1.0.0 beta 1 — dogfood build

Signed release candidate for stable 1.0.1. Please test on a physical device.

### Included
- Qibla tab with live compass, calibration guidance and no-sensor fallback
- Travel mode with a temporary city that never overwrites your saved home
- Home widget 2.0: 2x2/4x2, light/dark/AMOLED, localized labels, quick actions
- Prayer insights + Hijri calendar on the Times tab (local-only history)
- Stable/beta channel switch in Software Update, midnight alarm re-arm
- WCAG AA contrast across all palettes incl. AMOLED

### Focus
1. Adhan on lockscreen, Doze, after reboot and across midnight
2. Qibla compass accuracy; travel -> return home restores saved city
3. Widget launch no white flash; AMOLED and Arabic layouts
4. OTA install from beta, then switch back to stable with no data loss
5. 200% text in EN/FR/AR at 360dp; TalkBack and AMOLED contrast
